z_indicator.label: Z indicator
z_indicator.why: Z indicator is {delta} {unit} from your usual.
z_indicator.action: Re-measure and tell the flight surgeon if it stays off.
z_indicator.howToMeasure: Log the value by hand entry.
z_indicator.whyItMatters: A change from your own baseline can be an early sign.

abs_z_indicator.label: Absolute z indicator
abs_z_indicator.why: Absolute z indicator is {delta} {unit} from your usual.
abs_z_indicator.howToMeasure: Log the value by hand entry.
abs_z_indicator.whyItMatters: A change in either direction from your own baseline matters.

value_indicator.label: Value indicator
value_indicator.why: Value indicator is {delta} {unit} from the nearest limit.
value_indicator.howToMeasure: Count the sessions in the last 7 days.
value_indicator.whyItMatters: Low values over time raise risk.

sample_pattern.why: Two indicators have stayed in Watch for 3 days.
sample_pattern.action: Review the contributing indicators with the flight surgeon.
